title: fix(skills): preserve hyperlink theme color when bold/italic/font_size is set
claim: In xlsx_create.apply_cell, a hyperlink cell that also sets bold/italic/font_size must keep the Hyperlink named style's theme-10 link color; only font_color may change it.

evidence.source: On main skills/productivity/xlsx/scripts/xlsx_create.py:97-101 sets cell.style='Hyperlink', then :120-121 'if font_kw: cell.font = Font(**font_kw)' replaces the style font with a colorless bare Font. No upstream commit touched skills/productivity/xlsx since the fork base.
evidence.red: On main with only the new test (uv ephemeral env, openpyxl 3.1.5): test_hyperlink_font_overrides_keep_link_color -> 'assert (None is not None)' where the A2 font is 'name=None, ..., b=True, i=True, ..., color=None, ..., sz=14.0'.
evidence.negative_control: Replacing copy.copy(cell.font) with a fresh Font() -> new test fails with the same assertion (1 failed, 12 passed); restored.
evidence.adjacent: Full xlsx skill suite (13, covers xlsx_create/xlsx_edit/xlsx_read/etc.) passes; tests/skills/test_skill_document_contracts.py 29 passed/1 skipped; ruff clean. Former CI gate tests/skills/test_office_document_skills.py no longer exists on main (removed in 524c38a98a).

upstream_overlap: No PR/issue on xlsx hyperlink font color (gh search 'xlsx_create hyperlink', 'xlsx hyperlink font', issues 'xlsx hyperlink'; local title cache)
#89986 OPEN (teddiesloco), #89927 OPEN (adnankassem) touch xlsx_create.py - different defects, no font handling
#106090 OPEN (Yasin-Usman) moves openpyxl imports in xlsx_create.py - textual conflict on the import line only
notes: Production change identical in substance to the fork (copy.copy + setattr); test trimmed from 6 links/~30 asserts to 3 links. Behaviour side effect (intended): non-hyperlink cells with bold/italic/size now keep the default font name/size/scheme instead of a nameless Font. Fork body says openpyxl Font 'has no .copy()' - imprecise (StyleProxy.copy exists but is deprecated); immaterial. The skill tests are outside pyproject testpaths and need openpyxl, which the Hermes venv lacks: ran via 'uv run --no-project --with openpyxl==3.1.5 --with pytest'. Kanban baggage excluded. NOT_TESTED: rendering in Excel/LibreOffice (asserted via openpyxl reload only).
